usage.message: The input does not match the operation schema.
usage.hint: Run `board schema` to see the expected input and fix the arguments.

recovery.action: Fix the arguments using `board schema`.

wrong_id_kind.message: The ID is valid but names a different kind of object.
wrong_id_kind.hint: Pass the ID kind the operation expects, e.g. B<n> for a block or a task key for a task.

recovery.action: Pass the expected ID kind.

forbidden.message: The caller is not allowed to run this operation on this object.
forbidden.hint: Check which role may run the operation in `board schema`, or ask the operator.

recovery.action: Use an allowed role or ask the operator for access.

not_found.message: The project, task, block, comment or item does not exist.
not_found.hint: Check the ID with `board status` or `board task <KEY>`.

recovery.action: Check the ID and locate the object.

not_implemented.message: This operation is not available in this daemon build.
not_implemented.hint: Ask the operator to update the daemon to a build with this operation.

recovery.action: Update the daemon to a build with this operation.

block_not_open.hint: Read the task with `board task <KEY>` to see the current blocks.

recovery.action: Read the current blocks before choosing another action.

wrong_block_type.message: The operation does not apply to this type of block.
wrong_block_type.hint: Read the block type with `board task <KEY>` and use the operation for that type.

recovery.action: Use the operation for the current block type.

stale_comment_revision.message: The comment has a newer revision than the one acknowledged.
stale_comment_revision.hint: Read the latest comment revision, then acknowledge that revision.

recovery.action: Read the latest comment revision before acknowledging it.

turn_closed.message: The turn is closed: the task was submitted, moved or archived since.
turn_closed.hint: Read your open turns with `board inbox` and act only on a turn listed there.

recovery.action: Read your open turns and act only on a turn listed there.

not_turn_taker.message: This session has not taken the turn.
not_turn_taker.hint: Take the turn with `board inbox ack` first; only the session that took it can submit or return it.

recovery.action: Take the turn first; only the session that took it can submit or return it.

head_mismatch.message: The commit is not the head of the task's pull request, or the task has none.
head_mismatch.hint: Push the commit to the task's pull request branch and submit its head; if the task has none, ask the operator to link the pull request with `board link` first.

recovery.action: Push the commit to the task's pull request branch and submit its head; if the task has none, ask the operator to link the pull request first.

return_not_allowed.message: A task can be returned to Dev only from a column right of Dev.
return_not_allowed.hint: In Dev, ask with `board ask` instead.

recovery.action: In Dev, ask with a block instead of returning the task.

move_not_allowed.message: The task cannot be corrected to that column.
move_not_allowed.hint: Read why with `board task <KEY> --why`; pick an enabled column, and unlink a merged pull request with `board unlink` first.

recovery.action: Read why the task is where it is; pick an enabled column, and unlink a merged pull request first.

task_archived.message: The task is archived, so it cannot change.
task_archived.hint: Ask an operator to add the task to the board again if work continues.

recovery.action: Ask an operator to add the task to the board again if work continues.

link_conflict.message: Another linked pull request prevents this manual link.
link_conflict.hint: Read the task links and use a different task or resolve the existing pull request link.

recovery.action: Read the task links and resolve the blocking pull request.

retry_not_applicable.message: The item is not in a state that can be retried.
retry_not_applicable.hint: Read the item with `board task <KEY>`; close it if it needs no retry.

recovery.action: Read the item and close it if no retry is needed.

idempotency_key_mismatch.message: The idempotency key was already used with a different input.
idempotency_key_mismatch.hint: Use a new key for a new command, or repeat the earlier input with the same key.

recovery.action: Use a new key for new input or repeat the original input.

identity_unavailable.message: The daemon cannot tell who the caller is right now.
identity_unavailable.hint: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command later with its existing idempotency key if it has one.

recovery.action: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
recovery.retryTiming: After caller identity is available; wait briefly between retries.

starting.message: The daemon is still starting; nothing was applied.
starting.hint: Wait until the daemon is ready, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.

recovery.action: Wait until the daemon is ready, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
recovery.retryTiming: After the daemon is ready; wait briefly between retries.

stopping.message: The daemon is stopping; nothing was applied.
stopping.hint: Wait until the daemon is running again, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one; if it stays stopped, ask in your own session.

recovery.action: Wait until the daemon is running again, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one; if it stays stopped, ask in your own session.
recovery.retryTiming: After the daemon is running again; wait briefly between retries.

github_unavailable.message: GitHub did not confirm the pull request head; nothing was applied.
github_unavailable.hint: Wait until GitHub answers, then submit again.

recovery.action: Wait until GitHub answers, then submit again.
recovery.retryTiming: After GitHub is reachable; wait briefly between retries.

version_mismatch.message: The client and daemon catalog versions do not match; nothing was applied.
version_mismatch.hint: Run `board service restart` to update the daemon, then retry.

recovery.action: Run `board service restart`, then retry the command.

mcp.hint: Restart your agent session so `board mcp` loads the daemon's catalog; if the mismatch remains, run `board service restart`.

recovery.action: Restart your agent session; if the mismatch remains, run `board service restart`. Then retry the tool call.

daemon_unavailable.message: The daemon is not running or cannot be reached; nothing was applied.
daemon_unavailable.hint: Ask in your own session; the operator can check `board service status`, then run `board service restart`, or `board service install` if the service was never installed. Retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one once the daemon is available.

recovery.action: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
recovery.retryTiming: After the daemon is available; wait briefly between retries.

config.message: The configuration is missing or invalid.
config.hint: Fix the configuration file named in the error, then run the command again.

recovery.action: Fix the named configuration file and retry.

mcp.hint: Fix the variable named in `context.environmentVariable` where `board mcp` starts. Only when `context.configPath` is also present, making that config.yaml valid with an `http.port` works instead; `board doctor --offline` names what is wrong in it.

recovery.action: Fix the named variable or config.yaml, restarting your agent session after a variable change, then retry the tool call.

identity_missing.message: No caller identity was found: this is not a Spur session and no .spur-board/token was found walking up from the current folder.
identity_missing.hint: Run the command in a Spur session of a project listed in config.yaml, or run `board token create --name <name> --into <folder>` and ask the operator to approve the request in Slack.

recovery.action: Get a caller identity as the fix says, then run the command again.

service_start_failed.message: The service unit is installed, but the service did not start.
service_start_failed.hint: Read why it failed with `journalctl --user -u spur-board.service -n 100` and run `board doctor`; systemd keeps restarting the service until the cause is fixed.

recovery.action: Fix the cause shown by `journalctl --user -u spur-board.service -n 100` and `board doctor`, then run `board service restart`.

update_rolled_back.message: The update failed, so the board is back on the version it ran before.
update_rolled_back.hint: Fix the cause named in this error, then run `board update` again.

recovery.action: Fix the reported cause, then run `board update` again.

rollback_failed.message: A rollback step failed; the package, database or service may be only partly restored.
rollback_failed.hint: Fix the step named in this error, then run `board rollback --yes` again.

recovery.action: Fix the reported step, then run `board rollback --yes`.

outcome_unknown.message: The connection was lost after the request was sent; it may have been applied.
outcome_unknown.hint: Run the command again with the same idempotency key to learn the outcome.

recovery.action: Check the outcome, then retry with the same idempotency key if needed.
recovery.retryTiming: After checking the outcome, with a short delay.
recovery.outcomeCheck: Read the task or item with `board task <KEY>` before retrying.

unexpected.message: An unexpected failure occurred; the outcome may be unknown.
unexpected.hint: Use the trace reference in the daemon log; repeat reads or check a mutation outcome before retrying with the same key.

recovery.action: Check whether the request took effect. A read-only request can be repeated; for a mutation, retry with the same idempotency key only after checking the outcome.
recovery.retryTiming: After checking a mutation outcome, or after a short delay for a read-only request.
recovery.outcomeCheck: Check the operation result or state before retrying a mutation; a read-only request needs no outcome check.
